battleTraits.name: TAKE A RUN AT IT
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly BIG or LITTLE units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise.
• Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets.
• The target is building momentum for the rest of the turn.
• If the target is within 3" of a battlefield edge, remove it from the battlefield and set it up in reserve beyond the horizon.
• For the rest of the phase, the target can pass through enemy models and terrain features when using MOVE abilities as if it had FLY.

battleTraits.name: ARGY BARGY
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly BIG or LITTLE units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise.
• Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets.
• If the target is building momentum, it is no longer building momentum and is getting ready for the rest of the turn instead.
• For the rest of the turn, each time the target makes a pile-in move, add 3" to the distance it can move.

battleTraits.name: WRATHFUL RAMPAGE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise.
• Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets.
• If the target is LITTLE and is getting ready, it is no longer getting ready and has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn instead.
• If the target is BIG and is getting ready, it is no longer getting ready. Instead, either it has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn or it is prepping the big one for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: HARING BACK
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: If a friendly unit is in reserve beyond the horizon, you must pick that unit to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. If it is not possible to set it up, it wanders off and is automatically destroyed.

battleTraits.name: THE BIG ONE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly BIG or LITTLE units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise.
• Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets.
• If the target is prepping the big one, pick an enemy unit in combat with it and roll any number of dice. If any of the rolls are a 1, the target is no longer prepping the big one. Otherwise, add the results together, then inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the total.

battleTraits.name: TIMBERRRRR!
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Each time a friendly BIG unit or LITTLE unit model is slain, before removing it from play, the players must roll off. The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of that model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than that model.

battleTraits.name: THE WORLD TITAN’S PROPHET
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
While any other friendly BRODD’S STOMP units are within a friendly King Brodd’s combat range:
• That friendly King Brodd has WARD (5+).
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that friendly King Brodd, allocate 1 damage point to another friendly BRODD’S STOMP unit within its combat range after the damage sequence for that friendly King Brodd has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

battleTraits.name: WRATH OF BRODD
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly BIG unit that has not used a DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE ability this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: If the unit using this ability charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit can move 3D6" but must end that move in combat. When it does so, it can pass through terrain features and enemy models as if it had FLY.’

battleTraits.name: DOUBLE STOMP
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly BIG unit that has not used a DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE ability this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D6. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add the result to the Attacks characteristic of the Almighty Stomp of the unit using this ability.

battleTraits.name: CRAFTY CREEPERS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly BIG unit that has not used a DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy HERO that has an artefact of power and is in combat with that BIG unit to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target no longer has that artefact of power.

battleTraits.name: SMASH IT ALL TO BITS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly BIG unit that has not used a DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE ability this turn to use this ability, then pick a terrain feature within its combat range. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of that BIG unit to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D3 for each friendly and enemy unit on the terrain feature that was picked. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. After rolling for all those units, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: WATCH THIS!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly BIG unit that has not used a DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
If the target is a HERO, BEAST, MONSTER or WAR MACHINE, roll 6 dice. Otherwise, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each roll that is equal to or greater than the target’s Save characteristic, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
The BIG unit using this DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE ability has STRIKE‑LAST for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: I’VE HEARD SHE CAN...
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
... Shoot Fire From Her Eyes!: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each visible enemy unit within 12" of the friendly Ma Maegran.
... Turn You Into a Human!: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of the friendly Ma Maegran. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with that unit.
... Make Ya Big and Strong!: Pick another visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of the friendly Ma Maegran. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s weapons for the rest of the turn.
. . . Whiz the Biggest Bangers!: Add 1 to casting rolls for the friendly Ma Maegran until the start of your next turn.

battleTraits.name: OI! GERROFF!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: If the friendly Ma Maegran is in combat and damaged, pick up to 3 friendly Mancrusher Gargants on the battlefield that are visible to her to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Each target has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: SUMMON THE HERD
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: If the friendly Ma Maegran is on the battlefield, pick each enemy non-FLY non-MONSTER unit that is visible to her to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a number of dice for each target equal to the current battle round number. For each 4+, allocate 1 mortal damage to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

battleTraits.name: DON’T LET NUFFIN’ HAPPEN TO HER!
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
While the friendly Ma Maegran is within the combat range of another friendly LITTLE unit:
• She has WARD (5+).
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for her, allocate 1 mortal damage to another friendly LITTLE unit within her combat range after the damage sequence for her has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
• Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for that other friendly LITTLE unit’s combat attacks.

battleTraits.name: STOMP! STOMP! STOMP! STOMP!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a friendly STOMPER TRIBE unit to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for each friendly STOMPER TRIBE model in combat with the target.
On a 5+:
• The target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.
• Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target.

battleTraits.name: GET IN THERE, YOU RUNTS!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly LITTLE unit that is within a friendly BIG unit’s combat range, visible to it and not in combat to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn, and the target has FLY for the rest of the phase.

battleTraits.name: GRAB THOSE ROCKS AND CHUCK ’EM!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Shooting Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick each friendly LITTLE unit wholly within 18" of and visible to a friendly BIG unit and not in combat to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: GETTIN’ STUCK IN
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly STOMPER TRIBE unit in combat to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
If the target is LITTLE, pick a model in the target unit. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that model’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
If the target is BIG, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: STOMPIN’ ABOUT
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly LITTLE unit wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly BIG unit to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: That LITTLE unit can move D6+3". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit that has a lower Health characteristic than that LITTLE unit and that it passed across during that move.

abilities.name: ARROGANT BIG ’UNS
abilities.effect: In the first battle round, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target friendly BIG and LITTLE units that have not charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: TEN-LEAGUE STRIDES
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly BIG or LITTLE unit uses the ‘Redeploy’ command or the ‘Run’ ability, if you roll a 1-2 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 3 instead.

abilities.name: BRUTE SPIRITUALITY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly BIG or LITTLE unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy WIZARD or PRIEST within 18" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Make a rampage roll of D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic:
• The target has a maximum power level of 1 until the start of your next turn.
• All MANIFESTATIONS that were summoned by the target are banished and removed from play.

abilities.name: GET TO THE GOODS
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly BIG or LITTLE unit that charged in the same turn makes a pile-in move, that unit can pass across enemy models in non-MONSTER units.

abilities.name: STRIKE! HUR HUR!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly MEGA-GARGANT units within 3" of any terrain features and pick any friendly GARGANT units within 3" of any terrain features to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Double the Attacks characteristic of each target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn. If the target has no ranged weapons, pick an enemy unit within 12" of the target instead and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: LOFTY LOUTS
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Mancrusher Gargant unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly GARGANT units while they are wholly within 12" of the target and not wholly within 12" of any friendly MEGA-GARGANT units.

entries.name: PIPSQUEAK CURSE
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: ENERGY SURGE
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: If the target is BIG, add 1 to rampage rolls for it until the start of your next turn. If the target is LITTLE, until the start of your next turn, it can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN ability in the same turn.

entries.name: THORNFANG’S WRATH
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: The target’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: BEHEMAT’S VENGEANCE
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: MIGHT OF THE EARTH
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick each friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit on the battlefield to be the targets, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Heal (D3) each target. If the chanting roll was 8+, Heal (3) each target instead.

entries.name: WORLD TITAN’S STRIDE
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the target’s Move characteristic and models in the target unit can pass across enemy models and terrain features as if it had FLY. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, for the rest of the turn, each time the target uses the ‘Normal Move’ or ‘Run’ ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit the target passed across as part of that move.

entries.name: ROCK BOTTOM
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:
• Ignore the effects of the ‘Battle Damaged’ ability on each target.
• Each target has WARD (6+).

entries.name: THE TERRIBLE TOES
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the roll. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any enemy models are slain by this ability, halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: VOCAL TECTONICS
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, each target has STRIKE-LAST.

entries.name: Ancient Ghyrochs

abilityDetails.name: Beast
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilityDetails.name: Wellspring of Life Energy
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Heal (3) this unit.

entries.flavour: Long ago, the gargant civilisation - such as it was-tamedal sorts of massie meestauna, Pek of these creatures survive into the modern era, but Ma Maceran still shenherds the carthe brutes known as Ancient Gyrochs. The life magic of Ghyran resonates within their squat bodies: such power makes them difficult to slay and can he drawn upon by the Chooser of the Mighty if necessary.
entries.notes:
This unit can only be taken in Ma Maegran’s regiment.
This unit cannot be reinforced.

entries.name: Beast-smasher Mega-Gargant

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Menhir Club is 11 for Calamitous Sweep and 4 for Crushing Blow.

abilityDetails.name: Leader of the Pack
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a %000010870FIGHT ability% for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick another visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target and make a rampage roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if the target is LITTLE. On a 3+, the target’s melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Primal Aura
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Make a rampage roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll for each other friendly BIG or LITTLE unit that is in combat and within this unit’s combat range. On a 3+, subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by abilities used by this unit for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Menhir Club
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time this unit uses a FIGHT ability, pick either the Calamitous Sweep or Crushing Blow weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Menhir Club.

entries.flavour: Beast-smashers believe themselves to be possessed of all sorts of strange, primal powers - and it is best not to argue with them about this, since their tempers are notoriously foul. Towering brutes who are all but impervious to pain, they seek out the enemy's largest beasts, pulverising them with their menhir clubs. Beast-smashers seem to have quite the innate understanding of just how to take down these monstrous opponents, which often compels other gargants to idolise them and follow them around.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as an Eager Lout.

entries.name: Boss-Stompers

abilityDetails.name: Quit Hogging Da Fun!
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit in the enemy combat phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a visible friendly BIG unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved.

entries.flavour: Boss-stompers are considered to be rather dull and serious sorts by their kin. They see themselves as proper gargant warriors, not like the rest of the oafs they have to stomp around with. Mega-Gargants are respected for their size, but even they are often seen as lacking in the virtues of great fighters. This thoroughly annoys every gargant who interacts with the Boss-stompers- especially since these armoured brutes can back up their boasting.

entries.name: Gatebreaker Mega-Gargant

abilities: Rip It Up and Chuck It

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Fortcrusha Flail is 11 for Calamitous Sweep and 4 for Crushing Blow.

abilityDetails.name: Fortcrusha Flail
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time this unit uses a FIGHT ability, pick either the Calamitous Sweep or Crushing Blow weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Fortcrusha Flail.

abilityDetails.name: Rip It Up and Chuck It
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit that is not uprooted, then pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit within 3" of that terrain feature to be the target.
Effect: Make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+:
• If the target is another BIG unit, excluding Gatebreaker Mega-Gargants, it is armed with a Hurled Boulder for the rest of the turn (see the weapon profile on this unit’s warscroll. Modifiers to this unit’s ranged weapons or shooting attacks do not apply to the t

abilityDetails.name: Primal Reckoning
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Fortcrusha Flail: Crushing Blow for each friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit that has been destroyed this battle, to a maximum of 10.

entries.flavour: Cowled and sinister, Gatebreakers are gargant- shaped wrecking balls who take cruel joy in smashing down the civilised races fortresses and cities and then throwing the rubble at any survivors. To them, every structure is a target for their spiteful wrath, with the works of Sigmar and his followers especially hated. Gatebreakers seethe with bitterness over the death of Behemat - even if only subconsciously- and to watch other gargants fall to unworthy pipsqueaks only stokes their vandalising furore even hotter
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as an Eager Lout.

entries.name: King Brodd

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic o f this unit’s Obelisk of Tor Crania is 13 for Calamitous Sweep and 4 for Crushing Blow.

abilityDetails.name: Obelisk of Tor Crania
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time this unit uses a FIGHT ability, pick either the Calamitous Sweep or Crushing Blow weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Obelisk of Tor Crania.

abilityDetails.name: Power of Behemat
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
Effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of each target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Court of Creepers
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy HERO or MONSTER in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit charged this turn. On a 3+:
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
• The target cannot use RAMPAGE abilities for the rest of the turn.
• The target no longer has any artefacts of power.

abilityDetails.name: Set ’Em Up, Then Knock ’Em Down
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: If there are 3 or more friendly BIG or LITTLE models in combat with the target, apply the effect below. Otherwise, make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks while it is in combat with 2 or more friendly BIG or LITTLE models.

melee: Obelisk of Tor Crania: Calamitous Sweep
Obelisk of Tor Crania: Crushing Blow

entries.flavour: The infamous King Brodd leads his gargant brethren in a crusade against the forces of Sigmar. Drawing upon an ancient, primal power - as well as his own vast strength - he will stop at nothing to see the death of his godbeast forefather avenged. Brodd's authority is respected by gargants across the land, making him one of the few capable of geting the huge louts to act with something approaching coordination.

entries.name: Kragnos, the End of Empires

abilityDetails.name: Rampaging Destruction
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: If this unit charged this phase, pick 1 of the following effects:
• Roll a dice for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
• Pick an enemy MONSTER in combat with this unit and roll 2D6. On a 7, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the results on the dice used for the 2D6 roll multiplied together. For example, a 2D6 roll of 2 and 6 would inflict 12 mortal damage (2 × 6).

abilityDetails.name: Avatar of Destruction
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilityDetails.name: The End of Empires
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for friendly DESTRUCTION units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of The Dread Mace is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

abilityDetails.name: The Shield Inviolate
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per SPELL ability.

entries.flavour: A roaring, trampling god of earthquakes and wanton destruction, Kragnos is known as the End of Empires. This thuggish titan of a bygone age revels in violence and the chance to exert his brutish strength over others. Every sweep of his Dread Mace - charged with the power of the earth - reduces bodies to blood and ruin, even as the pited bronze surface of Tuskbreaker wards off blows both mystical and mundane.

entries.name: Kraken-eater Mega-Gargant

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Shipwrecka Warclub is 11 for Calamitous Sweep and 4 for Crushing Blow.

abilityDetails.name: Shipwrecka Warclub
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time this unit uses a FIGHT ability, pick either the Calamitous Sweep or Crushing Blow weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Shipwrecka Warclub.

abilityDetails.name: Get Orf Me Land!
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an objective or terrain feature on the battlefield to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the battle, the target is this unit’s loot hoard. While the unit that used this ability is contesting its loot hoard, add 10 to its control score. While the unit that used this ability is not contesting its loot hoard, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its Almighty Stomp.

abilityDetails.name: Greedy Show-Offs
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick another visible friendly BIG or LITTLE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: If this unit is contesting its loot hoard, apply the effect below. Otherwise, make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Kraken-eaters are grabbing, greedy coastal raiders who are fiercely territorial. Unfortunately, they consider everything they can see to be their territory and will fight with outraged indignation to take the spoils of war for their hoards. As elder gargants, Kraken-eaters prefer either to let the enemy come to them or to get their mates and lackeys to do the work before taking the plunder for themselves. Their propensity for showing off never fails to stoke the ire of more envious gargants
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as an Eager Lout.

entries.name: Ma Maegran, Chooser Of The Mighty

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Spear of Krum Kalda is 3.

abilityDetails.name: Creepy Cantrips
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to rampage rolls for the target and add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.

abilityDetails.name: The Wandering Witch
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of another friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER unit, this unit is not visible to enemy units more than 12" away from it.

abilityDetails.name: Shepherdess
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly Ancient Ghyrochs unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: If the target is within this unit’s combat range, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise, make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+, pick 1 of the effects below.
Gore their Guts!: If the target is in combat, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s Mighty Horns and Hooves for the rest of the turn.
Ghyroch Rush: If the target is not in combat, it can move 3". It can move into combat.
Reservoirs of Jade Energy: Add 1 to this unit’s casting power level until the start of your next turn.

abilityDetails.name: Chooser of the Mighty
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick another visible friendly LITTLE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be mighty.
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:
• For the rest of the turn, each time you make an unmodified wound roll of 6 for a combat attack made by the mighty unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target of the attack after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.
• Pick a point on the battlefield within 1" of the mighty unit, then pick a friendly non-UNIQUE BIG unit th

entries.flavour: Ma Maegran is an old, strange gargant indeed, Her reputation precedes her, enough that even the great Mega-Gargants show some nervous deference in her presence. Maegran is a seer and a witch who, it is said, has the power to grant the blessing of bigness to a worthy gargant. Yet it is also said that she can strip that same bigness from those who displease her, a fate that does not bear thinking of...

entries.name: Mancrusher Gargant

abilityDetails.name: Bet You Can’t...
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick each friendly Mancrusher Gargant on the battlefield to be the targets.
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:
...Kill the Big Eads: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons while they are in combat with any enemy HEROES or MONSTERS.
...Get There Before Me!: Up to 3 of the targets can each use the Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
...Grab That!: Add 5 to each target’s control score for the rest of the battle.

abilityDetails.name: Excitable Followers
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT HERO, this unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: When the earth shakes to the thunder of the Mega-Gargants' footfalls, their lesser brethren muster for war. No longer are they aimless nomads and indulgent drunkards; now they are war-hungry terrors inspired to violence by their towering brethren. Admittedly, Mancrushers are still eager, competitive sorts with a habit of getting in over their heads. Even then, though, they can cause havoc and disaster amongst enemy lines.

entries.name: Rock-hurlers

abilityDetails.name: Drop, Toss or Roll
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
Drop: This unit’s ranged weapons have Shoot in Combat and this unit can use the Covering Fire command even if it is in combat.
Toss: Add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons.
Roll: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks.

entries.flavour: To most gargants, being forced to remain at the back of a fight and chuck boulders at the enemy would be a humiliating lot. However, some find themselves developing quite a talent for it; known as Rock-hurlers, these gargants bond over their love of making tricky shots and satisfying splattering noises. Nevertheless, they are more than happy to wade in close if the mood strikes them.

entries.name: Scourge of Aqshy Gatebreaker Mega-Gargant

abilityDetails.name: Fortcrusha Flail
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time this unit uses a FIGHT ability, pick either the Calamitous Sweep or Crushing Blow weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Fortcrusha Flail.

abilityDetails.name: It’s Goin’ Down
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
• This unit has a Move characteristic of 4D6".
• While this unit is within 1" of a terrain feature, the Attacks characteristic of its Hurled Boulder is D6 instead of 1.

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Fortcrusha Flail is 11 for Calamitous Sweep and 4 for Crushing Blow.

abilityDetails.name: Off in a Huff
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: You and your opponent must roll off. Each player adds their fury level to their roll. Then, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat unless you won the roll-off.

entries.source: Scourge of Aqshy - Sons of Behemat
entries.flavour: Already prone to rage-filled outbursts at the sight of any trappings of civilisation, the furious spirit of Aqshy sees the Gatebreakers become even more unrestrainedly destructive. There is no stronghold, no hovel, no intentional pile of stones that will not draw their terrific ire.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as an Eager Lout. This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Aqshy Mancrusher Gargant

abilityDetails.name: Statue Tossing
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: For the rest of the turn, the Damage characteristic of this unit’s Throwin’ Rocks is 3 instead of D3.
Then, you can spend up to 3 rage dice. If you do:
• For each rage dice spent, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Throwin’ Rocks for the rest of the turn.
• If your opponent’s fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.

entries.source: Scourge of Aqshy - Sons of Behemat
entries.flavour: Inspired to violence by their towering Mega-Gargant brethren, the Great Parch echoes to the tread of Mancrusher Gargants stomping into the fray. Hurling rocks and walloping pipsqueaks, they cause utter havoc among the enemy lines.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Ghyran Kraken-eater Mega-Gargant

abilityDetails.name: Longshanks
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can pass through models in non-MONSTER units and parts of terrain features that are less than 4" tall.

abilityDetails.name: Emerge From The Deep
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is beneath the waves.
Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge.

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Shipwrecka Warclub is 3 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

abilityDetails.name: Sons of Behemat
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilityDetails.name: Lurking Beneath The Waves
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
Effect: Set up this unit in reserve beneath the waves. It has now been deployed.

entries.source: Scourge of Ghyran - Sons of Behemat
entries.flavour: Foul-tempered Kraken-eater Mega-Gargants haunt the Ghyranite coasts, periodically striding forth from the kelpy seas to smash, crush and destroy. Cunning for their usually oafish kind, Kraken-eaters can lurk just beneath the surface of the water for hours, waiting until their land-dwelling prey are at their most vulnerable before falling upon them like a tidal wave.
entries.notes:
This HERO can join an eligible regiment as an Eager Lout.
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2025-26 battlepack.

entries.name: Warstomper Mega-Gargant

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Titanic Boulderclub is 11 for Calamitous Sweep and 4 for Crushing Blow.

abilityDetails.name: Don’t Stomp Those, Stomp Them!
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick another visible friendly BIG or LITTLE unit wholly within 12" of this unit and that has not been set up this turn to be the target.
Effect: The target can move 2D6". It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that it was in combat with at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

abilityDetails.name: Almightier Stompin’
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
Effect: Make a rampage roll of D3. For the rest of the turn, add the roll to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Almighty Stomp, but all of this unit’s attacks made with that weapon must target the target unit.
If any models are slain by those attacks, for the rest of the turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Titanic Boulderclub
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time this unit uses a FIGHT ability, pick either the Calamitous Sweep or Crushing Blow weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Titanic Boulderclub.

entries.flavour: The veteran Warstompers seek out the thrill and clangour of battle wherever they can find it. They love smashing battlelines into disarray, and once they are in the thick of the fight, their rampage is al but impossible to stop. Warstompers take fighting very seriously, and one thing they absolutely cannot stand is any sort of horseplay on the par of more youthful or ebulient gargants. These sorts are given a good cuffing round the ear and shoved meaningfully towards the fray.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as an Eager Lout.
